sprint: Image Studio Redesign Ship A — right-column edit view, transparent checkerboard stage, before/after compare slider. Ports tools/background-remover/'s own layout to js/pictureStudio.js: the Edit view is now a fixed 320px right-side aside beside the stage instead of a bottom drawer, matching what a Story Author already knows from the standalone utility. The dark #1a1d24 stage fill is replaced with the familiar transparency checkerboard (via a new shared .checkerboard class — 20px tile, 45°/-45° gradients at 25%/75% stops with a 10px offset, matching the standalone tool byte-for-byte; --checker-a/--checker-b theme tokens with sensible defaults so the pattern renders in any theme, dark-theme variant included), and the canvas itself is transparent so removed-background pixels correctly read as transparency through the checker rather than punching through to a black fill that misrepresents the real edit. A Before ⇄ After compare slider (0-100, defaulting to 100) appears at the bottom of the Remove Background sub-panel only after a real bg-removal has completed — dragging it splits the canvas via ctx.clip(), drawing the original on the left portion and the removed-background result on the right, with a hairline gold divider at the split. Undoing bg removal resets the slider to 100 and hides it again. DOM restructured to accommodate the new layout: a new .picture-studio-body wrapper (flex column in Result view, flex row in Edit view) holds the stage plus whichever view panel is active, with the .picture-studio-edit-footer moved out to sit as a direct child of the modal root so it stays anchored at the bottom regardless of where the edit-view aside sits. Ship B (brushes for Remove More / Bring It Back, plus a crop tool) is scoped as a separate, future ship per the parent session's own AskUserQuestion answer.
task: Rewrote js/pictureStudio.js's modal structure to add DEFAULT_STATE.beforeAfterPct:100, wrap stage+result-view+edit-view in a new .picture-studio-body flex container appended to _root, moved editFooter to be a direct _root child, built the Before/After compare slider DOM (_baCompareWrap/_baSlider/_baHint) at the end of _buildBgSubPanel with the .hidden class initially, wired _refreshBgControls() to show/hide the wrap and reset _state.beforeAfterPct/_baSlider to 100 when there's no _bgRemovedImg, taught _undoBgRemoval() to reset the slider, and rewrote _render() to remove the black fill (transparent canvas so the .checkerboard stage shows through), with a new compareActive branch that uses ctx.clip() to paint _origImg on the left portion and the bg-removed img on the right portion with a hairline gold divider at pctX. css/style.css: retired the .picture-studio-stage's #1a1d24 fill and .picture-studio-canvas's #0e1015 fill, added .picture-studio-body row/column dispatch, added a shared .checkerboard class with dark-theme variant, made .picture-studio[data-view="edit"] .picture-studio-edit-view a 320px right-side aside with border-left, made .picture-studio-edit-footer display:none by default and only visible in edit view, and added .picture-studio-ba-compare/-label/-slider/-hint styles. Cache-bust bumped from ?v=0308 to ?v=0309 across every script/link tag in root index.html.
